note: Japanese American incarceration camps (the 10 War Relocation Authority centers; peak populations are approximate, from Densho and the National Park Service) and a selection of major federal Indian boarding schools. The Interior Department identified 408 federal boarding schools; this list is a starting point, not the full set.
